milestone_audit: All finalized serial byte references and frame hashes match actual data. Independent raw mailbox and QMP requests/replies corroborate before/after/finish and normal quit.
limits: Two concurrent controlled VM runs, no reliability distribution or native-device timing claim.
Timing measures captured guest hook ticks, not frame presentation or host log arrival.
Visual interpretation remains the parent operator review; this audit checks raw PPM dimensions/hash, not pixels semantically.
Milestone observer itself trusts in-memory operator flags and capture hashes; this independent audit additionally checks raw control/QMP transcripts.
TCP peer PID is unauthenticated; relay verifies claimed PID/UID/executable.
proposed_next_gap: A reusable read-only verify-report CLI that replays raw serial/control/QMP and timing checks into a portable source-hashed evidence bundle. Current independent audits are per-run scripts; milestone observation does not itself verify external transcript chronology. No implementation authorized here.
